title: Verify: useGame persistence and storage fallback unit tests
summary: Verify: useGame persistence and storage fallback unit tests
description: Unit tests written from the requirement spec with storage and DOM faked via jsdom; no server or browser is started.
acceptance_criteria: Tests fail without the Act and pass with it
Each test maps to a requirement acceptance criterion
technical_constraints: Reuse game/src runtime via imports; do not copy it

steps.action: Create setup importing '@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest' and an afterEach calling localStorage.clear() and vi.restoreAllMocks().
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/useGame.test.tsx

steps.action: With renderHook(useGame), call act('bookshelf','search'), unmount, renderHook again; assert result.current.state.flags.secret_door_open===true.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/useGame.test.tsx -t remount

steps.action: Spy on Storage.prototype.setItem to throw Error; renderHook(useGame), call act('bookshelf','search'); assert no throw and flags.secret_door_open===true. Also set getItem to return '{bad' and assert initial activeDialogue==='intro'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/useGame.test.tsx -t fallback
